data_description.start_offset: When the thermostat is switched on, the first setpoint sent is the room temperature plus this offset when heating (minus it when cooling), never beyond the target. A negative value gives a gentler start, a positive value a stronger one.
data_description.max_step: Maximum change of the setpoint per cycle, in degrees, in the direction that increases the demand. A lower target is sent at once. 0 means no limit.
